# CS101: Introduction to Computer Science

Course Code: CS101

## Description
This course provides a comprehensive introduction to core computer science principles, data structures, and algorithms.

## Learning Objectives
- Design and analyze basic algorithms.
- Implement fundamental data structures such as lists, trees, and graphs.
- Understand time and space complexity.

## Course Schedule

### Week 1: Introduction to Algorithms
- History of computing
- Algorithm efficiency and Big-O notation

### Week 2: Linear Data Structures
- Arrays and Linked Lists
- Stacks and Queues

### Week 3: Trees and Hierarchical Data
- Binary Search Trees
- Tree traversals (pre-order, in-order, post-order)

## Assessment
- Programming Assignments: 40%
- Midterm Quiz: 20%
- Final Project: 40%
